metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin for managing program plans as Gantt charts in Google Sheets — CLI does the dependency math (topological sort, working-days arithmetic, critical path); Sheet is the artifact PMs share.

plugins.name: gantt
plugins.description: Python CLI + Claude skill for Gantt-chart program plans in Google Sheets. Cascades dates from predecessors (FS/SS/FF/SF + lag), auto-derives task status, computes critical path, sorts rows by WBS id. NL routing skill maps prompts like 'OK2DC is 50% done' or 'pull task 5 in by 3 days' to CLI calls.
